name: Coronation Infrastructure Fund
source: Coronation Infrastructure Fund 2025 Annual Report, audited Statement of Comprehensive Income, filed with the Nigerian Exchange
unit: NGN, reported in N thousands. Revenue is total income, the printed Interest income plus the printed Other income. The fund prints no cost of sales line and no income tax line, so both are withheld rather than shown as zero.

checks.totalIncomeLessOpex: 2082046 less 130781 equals 1951265, the printed OPERATING PROFIT FOR THE YEAR; 1222685 less 517026 equals 705659, the printed comparative
checks.pbtLessTax: the fund prints no income tax charge, so Profit Before Tax equals the printed TOTAL COMPREHENSIVE INCOME FOR THE YEAR in both periods

note: 2025 is the fund first full year; the 2024 comparative comes from the same audited statement. EPS withheld: the report states no units in issue figure.
